chat.inicio.p1: Hi, I am Jéssica's portfolio guide. Where would you like to start?
chat.projetos.p1: There are four cases: Leadership Diagnostic, Motorline, Momentos and Coinple. Pick one and I will walk you through it.
chat.diagnostico.p1: Leadership Diagnostic started from one clear number: a single report took consultants about six hours to write.
chat.diagnostico.p2: Most of that time was not writing, it was gathering scattered documents and checking them by hand. So I centralised everything into one manager and put an AI in the flow to flag inconsistencies while they write.
chat.diagnostico.p3: The real turning point was flow, not looks. I rebuilt the information architecture so a full cycle runs without leaving the screen, and the vertical site map became horizontal.
chat.diagnostico.p4: The project was stopped by the end of investment before launch, so there are no live metrics. Want the full story, with the decisions and the trade offs?
chat.motorline.p1: At Motorline, the pain wasn't lack of data, but a disorganized excess spread across a spreadsheet with endless horizontal scrolling.
chat.momentos.p1: Momentos connects photographers and clients. Taking photos is instant, but slow manual delivery meant lost sales.
chat.coinple.p1: Coinple (a personal project) flips finance apps: it opens with green (what you have) instead of red (what you spent). It brings peace of mind.
chat.sobre.p1: Jéssica is a UI/UX and product designer who bridges design, development and business.
chat.contacto.p1: You can reach Jéssica by email at jeh.nabarro@gmail.com or on LinkedIn.
chat.fallback.p1: Hmm, apologies but I don't know the answer to that yet. I only have a few mapped answers, so please try exploring one of the options below.
chat.experiencia.p1: My path went through design, technology, programming, marketing and digital products.
chat.experiencia.p2: I like to understand the why before deciding the how. I have designed complex UX/UI solutions and translated those challenges into development.
chat.stack.p1: I work mainly with Figma for design, and HTML, CSS, Javascript (and frameworks) on the front-end.
chat.formacao.p1: I have continuous education and study in product design, UX/UI, and web development, always learning what the project demands.
chat.disponibilidade.p1: I am open to new challenges, both freelance projects and permanent roles. Send me a message and let's talk.
chat.motorline.p2: I created a hierarchical table that shows and hides information strictly on demand, supported by a consistent Design System.
chat.motorline.p3: The clear hierarchy made urgencies visible at a glance. I worked end-to-end, from wireframes up to the initial front-end build.
chat.momentos.p2: We designed a location and time-based app. Instead of tedious exports, clients receive their photos instantly via a QR Code.
chat.momentos.p3: Color became the product signature. I designed both the mobile applications and the landing page (momentos.art).
chat.coinple.p2: Yes, I started with "vibe coding". The AI generated a sterile interface, but my design brought human intention, replacing generic gradients with calm illustrations.
chat.coinple.p3: I integrated Apple Pay shortcuts so the tracking is invisible. I am still developing and improving it on my free time.
